volunteering.title: Off Campus Soph
volunteering.description: As an Off-Campus Soph at Western, I help first-year students who live off campus transition into university. During O-Week, I lead events and help students meet each other and get to know campus. All year, I run regular meetings and check-ins and mentor students so they feel connected and included in the Western community.
